correctness.rationale: The exact 24-vertex LCF graph has 36 edges, girth seven, diameter four and pair-distance counts 36/72/144/24, all reproducible. At scale two, independently ordered relative elementary-collapse certificates of 96 face pairs both finish exactly at the original graph. At scale three the graph of the 24 excluded pairs is exactly six disjoint four-cycles; thus the Rips complex is a sixfold join of disjoint two-edge complexes and has integral type S^5. The join orientation calculation and full 32-automorphism backtracking give 16 positive and 16 negative signs. Inclusion and barcode conclusions follow from the explicit relative collapse and disjoint homological degrees.

value.rationale: The unique cubic seven-cage is a canonical and highly structured finite graph, not a numerical slice chosen to fit a desired answer. The complete filtration exhibits a natural circle-wedge to five-sphere transition arising from a six-square distance-four decomposition, and the negative automorphism orientation detects a distinction invisible to ordinary Betti numbers. The eleven-dimensional pure Rips stage carrying five-dimensional homotopy is a meaningful topological boundary/example. No general cubic-graph theorem is overstated.
